# Forbes

> > Forbes is a global media company providing business news, financial information, and digital tools for advertising, subscriptions, and professional recognition.

Forbes offers a comprehensive ecosystem including Forbes Magazine, Forbes Digital Unlimited Articles, and business services such as the Forbes Ad Manager platform for self-service advertising and audience targeting. The site serves business professionals, advertisers, and readers seeking premium business content and recognition products.

## Key Topics

- Forbes Magazine
- Forbes Digital Unlimited Articles
- Forbes Ad Manager
- Self-service advertising
- Audience targeting
- Digital advertising
- Campaign management
- B2B marketing
- Forbes subscriptions
- Professional awards
- Company recognition
- Customer support
- Accolade store

## Advertising & Marketing Platform

- [Forbes Ad Manager](https://admanager.forbes.com/): Self-service advertising platform for brand partners and audience targeting

## Support & Help

- [Support](https://help.forbes.com/): Help center for Forbes subscriptions, magazine, and digital products

## Optional

- [Forbes Accolade Store](https://accoladesproducts.forbes.com/): Store for Forbes awards, accolades, and recognition products
